## v3.2.0 — 2026-06-11

This release introduces significant enhancements to the dashboard, allowing for configurable source repositories and Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) provider tokens. It also includes important fixes to ensure robust dashboard generation and explicit configuration requirements for hosted GitHub sources.

### ✨ Features

- The dashboard now supports configurable source repositories and the use of Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) provider tokens for enhanced security and flexibility.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Explicit GitHub repository configuration is now required for hosted source environments in the dashboard, addressing previous implicit behaviors.
- The API now includes a hosted GitHub fallback mechanism to ensure more robust dashboard generation.

### 🧹 Chores

- Updated internal documentation, including v3.1.1 release notes and a landing page hero badge.
- The project version has been bumped to v3.2.0.
